entries.text: Work item lists, boards, calendars, details, notifications and project membership now update on their own when someone else changes them. No more F5.
A refresh button in the top bar reloads the content on screen without reloading the whole page, so your scroll position and open panels stay.
You can reply to a comment. Replies sit under the comment they answer, and the author is notified once.
A Secretary level between Manager and Director, with the same view across the organisation as a Director. Profiles now show the level even when someone has no department.

Attaching files is more reliable from the button, drag and drop, and paste, in comments, chat and when creating a work item. A failed upload now tells you why and retries on its own when the network blips.
Onboarding now follows your language everywhere, and a new workspace gets its sample project in the owner's language.
